name: Brandfolder Assets
description: Field widget to browse and import assets (images, video, PDF) from the Brandfolder DAM.
project_description:
This module provides the ability to access media such as videos, images, PDFs and the like from the BrandFolder API.

You can add the field to the content type to do that to the brandfolder media.

 The setting of the popup can be changed from the brandfolder asset configuration

This setting configuration allows the title and extension of the popup to be shown and hidden

And you can also change the label of the field button in the content node.

 This setting configuration will apply equally to all content types. where this field is used.

 Brandfolder Asset Setting Configuration 
 :-

 /admin/config/media/brandfolderassets

 Features include: 
 - Field and Media from brand folder api

- Create as many custom fields in the content type for images and files assets as needed

- Enter image and file from popup.

- Popup setting configuration section.

 ... with more features coming soon.

 Requirements for 8.x and 9.x releases: 
 Brandfolder
